name: Gilded Mutton-Fat Jade Porcelain Set
marketing_tip: Indulge in the luxurious feel of mutton-fat jade porcelain with delicate gold accents.
body: Crafted from high-grade mutton-fat jade porcelain, this set is adorned with elegant gold-painted details. It offers a smooth, tactile experience and a visually stunning presentation for your finest teas.
